text: The system shall return only chunks that belong to the caller's tenant and that the caller's roles allow.
need: Customers must not see each other's data

text: The system shall reject any answer that cites a chunk that was not retrieved, or that cites nothing.
If a stored chunk no longer matches its recorded hash, then the system shall skip it.
need: Tampered knowledge must not reach the model

text: If the saved index or its signature has been altered, then the system shall refuse to load it.
need: A swapped index file must not become trusted knowledge

text: The system shall load only .pdf and .txt files from a folder, and shall skip symlinks and oversized files.
The system shall apply the tenant and role filter to keyword search and hybrid search exactly as to vector search.
need: A second search path must not bypass isolation

text: The system shall stop the agentic retrieval loop after at most max_attempts retrievals and shall then answer that it does not know.
The system shall record only fingerprints and lengths of prompts and answers in telemetry, never their text.
need: Telemetry must not become a copy of customer data

text: The system shall fail loudly when a model has no configured price.
need: Unknown cost must not pass silently

text: The system shall keep each user's memories private to that tenant and user.
need: One user must not read another's memories

text: The system shall redact PII and secrets before saving a memory and shall save only what the user explicitly asked to remember.
need: Poisoned or sensitive text must not become permanent

text: The system shall let a user delete one or all of their memories.
The system shall run at most max_handoffs specialist steps per request and shall never let a specialist read another tenant's orders.
need: Bounded delegation and isolation across agents
design: supervisor plan and dispatch; tenant-scoped orders

text: The system shall fail the release gate if any golden-set answer leaks forbidden text.
The system shall fail the release gate when answer quality drops more than the tolerance below the saved baseline.
